title: Attack on fishermen in Sirik leaves 3 injured
text:
Attack on fishermen in Sirik leaves 3 injured"

"🔆🔅According to Hormozgan Provincial Governorate, an incident involving an unidentified drone and injuries to three people has been confirmed."

"- Also, according to information received from local sources, a fishing boat is transferring the injured to shore."

"- Local sources have reported that a fishing vessel was targeted in the Sirik fishing zone; however, details of how the incident occurred and how the vessel was targeted have not yet been officially announced.
